markdown_content: ## Overview of Custom 2D Measurements in Clo3D This section introduces the concept of custom 2D measurements for graphics placement within Clo3D patterns. Custom measurements allow precise specification of graphic positions on garments, facilitating clear communication with collaborators or manufacturers about where to place graphics. --- ## Accessing and Using Custom Measurements for Graphics Custom measurements enable users to specify exact points on pattern segments related to graphic placement. Using the **Edit Graphic** tool in the 2D window, you can right-click on a graphic and select the **Custom Measurement** option. This lets you place measurement points anywhere along the pattern outline where the graphic is located. ### Procedure for Adding Custom Measurements 1. Open the 2D window and select the **Edit Graphic** tool. 2. Right-click on the graphic and choose **Custom Measurement**. 3. Click anywhere on a pattern segment that intersects or relates to the graphic. 4. Name the measurement point descriptively, e.g., "High Point Shoulder" or "Center Back." 5. Repeat this process to add multiple reference points around the graphic for precise location data. For example, you might place one point at the high shoulder seam and another near the armhole, capturing the exact coordinates relative to these pattern features. --- ## Viewing and Exporting Custom Measurement Data All custom measurement data appears in the property editor below the 2D window for easy reference. This data can be exported in multiple ways: - **2D Snapshot Export**: Use **File > Snapshot > 2D Window** to capture an image of the pattern with graphics and measurement points. Options include toggling pattern outlines, additional measurement data, graphic bounding boxes, and transparent backgrounds for clearer visuals. This snapshot is useful for including in pitch sheets or sharing with teams. - **Techpack JSON Export**: Exporting via **File > Export > techpack.json** includes custom measurement data in the technical specification file. This enables seamless integration into production workflows. ### Future Integration Plans Custom graphic measurement data will be incorporated into Clo3D’s native **Techpack** and **PRM** (Product Resource Management) systems, enhancing traceability and standardization, though this functionality is not yet available. --- ## Technical Details About Custom Measurement Behavior - The custom measurement points are calculated relative to the **bounding box** of the graphic, not the graphic’s center or other internal points. - This means the measurement snaps to the graphic’s outline edges in the pattern, ensuring accuracy even if the graphic is offset from the pattern itself. - The system captures distances from pattern segments (e.g., armhole, center back) to the graphic bounding box edges for precise placement instructions. --- ## Benefits and Use Cases Custom 2D measurements for graphics in Clo3D facilitate: - Clear communication of graphic placement specifications to manufacturers, collaborators, or team members. - Faster, more accurate documentation of detailed graphic locations within garment patterns. - Enhanced technical packs and documentation with precise graphic location data. - Improved workflow efficiency by eliminating guesswork about graphic positioning in shared files. --- ## Summary Clo3D’s custom measurement feature for graphics provides a powerful way to mark exact graphic placement points on garment patterns. It supports multiple measurement points per graphic, exports detailed measurement data in snapshots and techpack files, and bases measurements on the graphic bounding box for precision. This feature streamlines communication and documentation, enabling designers and manufacturers to align on graphic placement requirements effectively.
